mostWorthwhile.text: Reusing recovered iron in new red blood cells was most worthwhile: it connected old cells breaking down with the marrow making replacements.

leastWorthwhile.text: The skin-cell combination was straightforward from the picture, so it involved little figuring out, though the result showed how the layers renew.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the recovered iron to be carried by proteins in the blood before being reused.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary; the pictures and goals explained why the pieces belonged together.

continue.text: I'd choose to continue because following the iron from worn cells to new ones made me curious about other ways the body renews itself.
